And here is how we should do it. Empower the people to make their own healthcare decisions. Eliminate insurance companies from deciding what care they get. Stop monopoly hospital systems from forcing members to stay within their system. 

Allow people to seek improved care out of state. Get cutting edge therapies. Join research programs at any university. 

Take a single person’s HSA and give them the negotiating power of thousands of people. Get pre-set pricing on most services. Free people from being tied to an employers insurance offerings 

I have a plan for free market healthcare. Better care. Lower rates. Better cash flow for all healthcare providers. But I need a lot of help to get it done. 

Form healthcare unions similar to credit unions in the financial world. Members join for small fees and enroll their HSAs with these health care unions. 

These unions negotiate with providers for discounted fees. Imagining services, radiology, blood work, dialysis, everything. With several thousand members they can negotiate volume discounts by delivering bulk business. 

Employers make direct contributions, tax free, to a member’s  HSA equivalent to what insurance coverage now costs employers meaning $1,500-2,000 per month. 

When a member needs a service his/her PCP writes a script, patient gets service, then he/she uses a debit card based on their HSA to make a same day payment. 

Individuals pay for service as needed at much lower rates but carry high deductible catastrophic coverage for major events.  With deductibles of $25,000 or even $50,000…..depending on amount in HSA…..the cost would be minimal.  

Purely 💯 optional. Faster service.  Discounted rate for both volume from the healthcare union and for instant cash payment.  No complicated forms. Less staff needed. Better cash flow. 

There are many more huge benefits that are too many to discuss here.
